purpose: Canonical release governance model for promoting the MarketingOps platform safely and coherently.

promotion_model.working_rule: Production promotion must come from a clean release-shaped path, not from a mixed dirty worktree.
release_principles: Promote from coherent release slices only
Separate active workstreams before production promotion
Treat deployment provenance and trust posture as release requirements
Do not let legacy or pilot lanes ride silently inside core production promotion

release_gates.label: Verification
release_gates.description: Canonical app, API, and guardrail checks pass on the release candidate.

release_gates.label: Ownership
release_gates.description: The release slice has a clear canonical owner and does not mix unrelated outcome ownership by accident.
required_checks: No accidental canonical ownership from legacy lanes

release_gates.label: Trust
release_gates.description: The release candidate matches the expected Zero Trust and permission posture for the affected surfaces.
required_checks: Offering/action permissions aligned for affected surfaces

release_gates.label: Provenance
release_gates.description: The release can be traced to a coherent branch/workstream slice and deployment target.
required_checks: Cloudflare release auth health verified for non-interactive deployment

active_workstream_lanes.label: Platform / App
active_workstream_lanes.scope: Core Pond product shell, Watchtower, auth/bootstrap, permissions, control plane

active_workstream_lanes.label: Data Collection Hardening
active_workstream_lanes.recommended_branch: dedicated follow-up or release slice only when coherent
active_workstream_lanes.scope: Collection orchestration, retry, closure, alerting, freshness, source governance

active_workstream_lanes.label: Content Operations
active_workstream_lanes.scope: Intelligence Office, Site Content Creator, Search Intelligence, VACS

active_workstream_lanes.label: Zero Trust / SSO
active_workstream_lanes.scope: Cloudflare Access, Keeper rollout, role model, SSO blueprint, trust hardening

active_workstream_lanes.label: EVS / BrowserStack
active_workstream_lanes.scope: Experiential validation, BrowserStack execution, validation workflow maturity

active_workstream_lanes.label: Pilot Reporting
active_workstream_lanes.scope: Pilot CWV, pilot roundup, tracker-adjacent pilot reporting and exports

anti_patterns: Promoting directly from a giant mixed worktree
Bundling pilot or specialized work silently into core production release
Shipping trust-boundary changes without route and permission verification
Letting legacy systems define release scope for canonical product surfaces
next_moves: Keep the release-reconcile path as the canonical production promotion base
Continue separating work by coherent outcome/workstream lanes
Add deployment provenance and service-level posture to Watchtower over time
Use the release gates as the standard review language for production candidate approval
Fail fast on invalid Cloudflare admin credentials before attempting Wrangler-based promotion
